text:
Sam K: Quick rollcall — we have the schema migration + staggered data migration tonight at 23:00 UTC. Who's owning the deploy and who can run the smoke checklist?
Priya R: I can own the deploy + monitoring. I'll be on from 22:30-01:30 UTC. Need someone to run the smoke script and validate traffic after promote.
Liam T: I can run smoke and do the post-promote verification (latency + error-rate). Will join at 22:45.
Sam K: Thanks. Quick checklist I usually follow:
- snapshot prod DB pre-migration
- run migration on a single replica to validate
- run smoke.sh (see snippet)
- promote and monitor 15min, then re-enable full traffic

Sam K: ```
# run smoke locally against prod-like env
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --routes=api,worker --timeout=300
```
Jorge M: Rollback plan reminder: keep the previous migration tagged and the last snapshot available. If migration fails, we run reverse migration and restore from snapshot if needed. I'll be ready to help with DB restore.
Priya R: Can we pause async consumers for the first 15 minutes of the dual-write warmup window? That reduces replay noise.
Liam T: Yes — I'll quiesce queue consumers and re-enable after smoke passes.
deploy-bot: Reserved deployment slot 23:00-23:45 UTC (owner: @Priya R). Lock acquired.
Sam K: Admin ops note: tag the release as `release/migration-220123` before deploying, and attach the pre-migration snapshot ID to the ticket. If anything looks off during smoke (error spike >2% or latency >2x baseline), rollback immediately.
Priya R: Got it. Will tag as `release/migration-220123` and post snapshot ID here once complete.
Liam T: I'll post smoke results — testing: sample reads, key counts, and a few write-reads for affected tables.
Jorge M: I'll stand by for any restore or reverse migration steps. Also, confirm telemetry hooks are enabled (query perf, locks, migration duration).
Sam K: One more: keep migration logs verbose `--verbose` so we can triage quickly. Ping here when you start each step. :thumbsup:
Priya R: Starting preflight at 22:30 (snapshot + replica run). Will report progress.
Liam T: I'll be online and ready at 22:45 to run smoke and verify.
Sam K: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone can't make the window, shout now so we can reschedule.
Priya R: All good from my side.
Liam T: all set.
Jorge M: Ready.
Sam K: Closing rollcall — see you in the thread during the window.
